onboarding.description: Beginner help for new HR admins (phase 5, 2026-10-01): every HR field a first-month admin could stall on. Exempt from the 4-per-screen cap. Thin it by removing a workspace here, not by deleting entries one by one.

payroll.tax_declaration.description: Investment declaration rows — My Tax & Investments › Declarations (MyTaxAndInvestmentsPage › DeclarationsTab)

section.hint: The part of the income-tax law this saving comes under. It decides how much of it can lower your tax.

askMaya.question: Which income tax section should I choose when declaring an investment or expense, and what kinds of payments count under 80C, 80D, 80CCD(1B), HRA and LTA?

proof_reference.hint: A link or receipt number that shows you paid. HR checks it before the amount counts towards your tax saving.

askMaya.question: What counts as proof for a tax-saving declaration, and how does HR check it?

verified_amount.hint: The amount HR accepted after checking your proof. It can be lower than what you declared if a receipt is missing or doesn’t cover it all.

askMaya.question: Why can the amount HR accepts for my tax declaration be lower than what I declared?

payroll.tax_regime.description: Old vs new regime choice — My Tax & Investments › Regime (MyTaxAndInvestmentsPage › RegimeTab)

regime_code.hint: The set of rules used to work out your income tax. Under the old one your declared savings count; under the new one most don’t.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between the old and new income tax regime, and how do I decide which one to choose for this financial year?

payroll.bank_details.description: Salary bank account editor — My Salary › Bank details (MySalaryPage)

ifsc_code.hint: An 11-character code for your bank branch, such as SBIN0001234. It’s on your cheque book or passbook and in your bank’s app.

askMaya.question: What is an IFSC code, and where can I find the one for my bank branch?

account_type.hint: Whether this is a savings or a current account. Salary almost always goes into a savings account.

askMaya.question: Should my salary be paid into a savings account or a current account, and what is the difference between them for salary payments?

attendance.regularization.description: Attendance correction request — My Attendance › Corrections › New request (RegularizationCard › RegularizationFormModal)

work_mode.hint: Where you worked that day. Leave it as recorded unless it was logged wrongly — it only changes if the correction is approved.

askMaya.question: When I request an attendance correction, what does the ‘Worked from’ option mean, and what is the difference between office, remote, field and hybrid work?

payroll.reimbursement_claim.description: Expense line in a reimbursement claim — My Reimbursements › New claim (MyReimbursementsPage › ClaimEditorDialog)

category_id.hint: The type of expense, such as travel or food. Your organisation sets these, and each can have its own limit and receipt rule.

askMaya.question: How do I choose the right expense category for a reimbursement claim, and when do I need to attach a receipt?

documents.upload.description: Add a document / upload a new version (shared DocumentUploadDialog — also used by HR and managers, hence the workspace gate)

document_number.hint: The number printed on the document itself, such as a PAN or passport number. It’s stored securely; only the last 4 characters are shown.

askMaya.question: Why does HR Clouds ask for the number printed on a document, and how is it kept safe?

is_confidential.hint: Hides this document from your manager — only you and HR can see it. Once it’s confidential, it can’t be made visible again.

askMaya.question: What happens when I mark a document as confidential, who can still see it, and can I change it back later?

leaves.apply.description: Apply for leave drawer (LeaveDashboard › ApplyLeaveDrawer; also mounted under the HR and manager prefixes). Holds the form field plus the balance strip: `pending_hold` is summed client-side from requests still pending, and “Effective” = current_balance − pending_hold (explained in the same hint).

leave_type_id.hint: The kind of leave you’re taking, such as sick or casual. Each has its own balance and rules; days beyond your balance may be unpaid.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between leave types such as casual, sick and earned leave, and what happens if I apply for more days than my leave balance?

pending_hold.hint: Days in your requests still waiting for approval. They’re set aside, so “Effective” is what you can still apply for.

askMaya.question: What does pending hold mean on my leave balance, and when are held days given back or taken from my balance?

attendance.summary.description: Month headline figures from /attendance/graph-data › summary (EmployeeDashboard › My month)

punctuality_percentage.hint: Of the days you clocked in this month, the share you arrived on time. Arriving within your grace period still counts as on time.

askMaya.question: How is on-time arrival worked out in attendance, and what is the grace period for clocking in late?

attendance.anomalies.description: My Flags list (/attendance/anomalies/mine) › “Flag” column — `type`, falling back to `anomaly_type`

type.hint: Your manager or HR reviews each flag and marks it sorted out. If one looks wrong, talk to them — you don’t need to raise it anywhere else.

askMaya.question: What does it mean when my attendance is flagged, for example outside the office location or a break over the limit, and what should I do about it?

leaves.balances.description: Leave balance cards (/leaves/my-balances) — one ⓘ on the “Leave Balances” heading covers “given so far” (`total_accrued`) on every card

total_accrued.hint: “Given so far” is the leave added this year — all at once or month by month, depending on your policy. “Days left” is what you can still take.

askMaya.question: How is leave added to my balance during the year, and what happens to unused leave at the end of the year?

unpaid_days.hint: Days beyond your leave balance are taken without pay, so that month’s salary is lower. The split is worked out when you submit.

askMaya.question: What is leave without pay (LWP), when does leave become unpaid, and how does it reduce my salary?

payroll.my_salary.description: My Salary headline (/payroll/me/salary-structure). `take_home_monthly` is derived by statutoryTotals() — gross minus statutory and salary deductions.

annual_ctc.hint: The company’s total yearly cost for you, not what you’re paid. Deductions such as PF and tax come off first, so what reaches your bank is lower.

askMaya.question: What is CTC (cost to company), and why is my take-home pay lower than my CTC?

take_home_monthly.hint: An estimate from your salary structure. What actually reaches your bank each month can change with unpaid leave, attendance and tax.

askMaya.question: Why can the salary that reaches my bank differ from month to month, and what affects my take-home pay?

payroll.statutory.description: Statutory deduction lines (StatutoryBreakdown AmountTable). Wired generically by `line.key` (pf, esi, pt, tds, pf_employer, esi_employer, edli, pf_admin) — only the keys listed here show an ⓘ.

pf.hint: Part of your pay saved into your provident fund account, with the company adding its own share. It’s your money, for retirement.

askMaya.question: What is the provident fund (EPF) deduction from salary, how much is deducted, and how can I withdraw or check my PF balance?

pt.hint: A small tax charged by some states on salaried people. Whether it applies, and how much, depends on the state you work in.

askMaya.question: What is professional tax, how is it calculated, and why does it differ between states?

payable_days.hint: The days you’re paid for this month. Unpaid leave and unrecorded absences bring it below the number of days in the month.

askMaya.question: What are paid days on a payslip, and why can they be fewer than the days in the month?

remaining_tds.hint: Income tax for the year that hasn’t been taken from your pay yet. It’s spread over the months left, so it changes if your pay or declarations do.

askMaya.question: How is income tax (TDS) deducted from my salary each month, and why does the monthly amount change during the year?

previous_employer.hint: Pay and tax from a job you left earlier this financial year. It’s added in so your tax for the whole year is worked out correctly.

askMaya.question: Why does income from my previous employer this year affect my tax, and what is Form 12B?

standard_deduction.hint: A fixed amount taken off your salary before tax is worked out. It’s given automatically — you don’t need to declare or prove anything.

askMaya.question: What is the standard deduction on salary income, and how does it reduce my income tax?

form16.hint: Your yearly tax certificate from the company. Part A lists the tax deposited for you; Part B shows how it was worked out. You use it to file your return.

askMaya.question: What is Form 16, what is the difference between Part A and Part B, and how do I use it to file my income tax return?

payroll.loans.description: Loan detail dialog (/payroll/me/loans) › “How interest is worked out” (`interest_method`)

interest_method.hint: Flat charges interest on the full amount for the whole loan. “On what’s still owed” charges it only on the unpaid part, so it costs you less.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between flat interest and reducing balance interest on a salary loan?

divisor_days.hint: Your monthly pay is divided by this many days to get one day’s rate. The number is set by your company’s policy.

askMaya.question: How is the amount for leave encashment calculated, and what does dividing the month by a number of days mean?

payroll.reimbursement_limits.description: My Claims & Benefits › Limits tab (/payroll/me/reimbursements/categories) › “Period limit” column

period_limit.hint: The most you can claim in this category in each period, such as a month. It starts again each period; “Per claim” caps a single claim.

askMaya.question: How do reimbursement limits work, what is the difference between a per-claim limit and a period limit, and when do they reset?

status.hint: In review: HR hasn’t checked it yet. Action required: HR sent it back — upload it again. Not finished: the upload didn’t complete.

askMaya.question: What do the document statuses in review, action required, not finished and expiring soon mean, and what do I need to do for each?

documents.company_documents.description: My Company Documents › status filter (`compliance_state`: pending, overdue, completed, waived)

compliance_state.hint: Needs you: read, acknowledge or sign it. Overdue: its due date has passed. Excused: HR decided you don’t need to act on it.

askMaya.question: What do I need to do with documents issued to me by the company, and what do needs you, overdue and excused mean?

payroll.adjustment_proposal.description: Salary Adjustments — the manager proposes, HR creates directly. Same fields, same dialog shape (ManagerAdjustmentsPage / PayrollAdjustmentsPage).

adjustment_type.hint: Add a one-off amount to their pay, or take one off, in the month you choose. Their salary structure doesn’t change.

askMaya.question: What is a one-off salary adjustment, and how is an extra earning or a deduction for one month different from a salary revision?

component_name.hint: The name shown for this line on their payslip, such as Spot Award. Leave it blank to use a standard name.

askMaya.question: How does a one-off pay adjustment appear on a payslip, and what name does it show under?

period_month.hint: The pay month this is added to or taken from. It has to be a month whose payroll isn’t approved or paid yet.

askMaya.question: Why can a pay adjustment only be added to a month whose payroll is not yet approved or paid?

payroll.bonus_proposal.description: A one-off bonus — the manager proposes, HR creates directly (ManagerAdjustmentsPage / PayrollAdjustmentsPage).

bonus_type.hint: Flat ₹ gives everyone the same amount. The % options work it out from each person’s basic or gross pay, so Value is then a percentage.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between basic pay and gross pay, and how is a bonus worked out as a percentage of each?

payroll.loan_recommendation.description: A loan or salary advance — the manager recommends, HR creates it and sets the schedule (ManagerAdjustmentsPage / PayrollLoansPage).

loan_type.hint: A salary advance is pay given early; a company loan is money the company lends. Both are paid back in monthly instalments from salary.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between a salary advance and a company loan, and how is each paid back from salary?

tenure_months.hint: The number of months it’s paid back over. One instalment is taken from their pay each month.

askMaya.question: How is a loan or salary advance paid back from salary over its tenure?

start_period_month.hint: The pay month the first instalment is taken from their salary. The rest follow month by month.

askMaya.question: How is the first repayment month of a loan or salary advance chosen, and what happens after it?

payroll.salary_revision.description: A new salary — the manager proposes, HR assigns it directly (TeamSalaryPage / EmployeeSalaryStructuresPage).

annual_ctc.hint: The company’s total yearly cost for them, not what they’re paid. PF, tax and other deductions come off first, so take-home is lower.

askMaya.question: What is included in CTC (cost to company), and how does a change in CTC affect monthly take-home pay?

revision_type.hint: Why the pay is changing: a regular raise, a promotion, fixing an earlier mistake, or a restructure of how the pay is split. It’s kept on record.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between a salary increment, a promotion, a correction and a restructure when revising someone’s salary?

effective_from.hint: The date the new pay starts. It must be after the current salary’s start. If it falls in a month already paid, the difference comes in a later payroll.

askMaya.question: What happens when a salary revision starts from a date in a month that has already been paid?

payroll.encashment_proposal.description: Manager asks HR to pay a report for earned leave days — Encashments › Cash out earned leave.

period_month.hint: The pay month the cash-out is added to once HR approves it. Pick a month whose payroll isn’t approved or paid yet.

askMaya.question: How does a proposed leave payout reach someone’s pay, and which pay month can it go into?

payroll.claim_review.description: Item-by-item approval of a reimbursement claim — ClaimDecisionDialog, shared by the manager (step 1) and HR (final) reviews.

category_limits.hint: How much of each expense type’s limit is left for this person after what you approve. Going over is refused, so lower the amount to fit.

askMaya.question: How do expense category limits work for reimbursement claims, and what happens when an approved amount would go over the limit?

documents.recommendation.description: Manager’s verify/reject recommendation on a report’s document — RecommendDialog in DocumentDetailDialog (manager plane only).

recommendation.hint: Normally HR makes the final call. If your organisation gives managers direct authority, your recommendation decides it straight away.

askMaya.question: What does a manager’s recommendation to verify or reject an employee’s document mean, and who makes the final decision?

documents.request.description: Asking one person for one kind of document — RequestDocumentDialog, shared by HR (#80) and managers (#93).

due_on.hint: Leave it blank to use your organisation’s standard time limit. Reminder emails go out automatically until it’s provided.

askMaya.question: How do due dates and reminder emails work when HR or a manager asks someone for a document?

documents.upload_for_report.description: DocumentUploadDialog when someone uploads for another person — the manager’s Upload for a report, HR’s request and profile uploads. Chosen by the host’s helpSurface prop.

document_number.hint: The number printed on the document itself, such as a PAN or passport number. It’s stored securely; only the last 4 characters are shown.

askMaya.question: Why is the number printed on a document recorded, and how is it kept safe?

is_confidential.hint: Only HR and the employee can see it — managers can’t, even one who uploaded it. Once it’s confidential, it can’t be made visible again.

askMaya.question: What happens when a document is marked confidential, who can still see it, and can it be made visible again later?

attendance.approval_queue.description: Columns of the shared attendance approval queue (AttendanceApprovalQueue) — manager request pages, the manager Inbox and the HR Inbox/HR queues.

work_mode.hint: Where they worked: first as recorded, then what they’re asking to change it to. It only changes if the correction is approved.

askMaya.question: What does an attendance correction for work mode change, and when does it take effect?

days_earned.hint: Half or a full day, depending on the hours worked on the holiday or weekly off. Once approved it’s added to their leave and expires if unused.

askMaya.question: How is comp-off earned for working on a holiday or weekly off, how many days does it give, and when does it expire?

leaves.approval.description: Leave approvals — the manager's LeaveRequestCard (Leave Requests, Inbox) and HR's own leave request dialog. paid_split is the Paid/Unpaid split; balance_after is the balance once the request is approved, so it is wired only on the approval case, never on a cancellation where the same tile means the opposite.

paid_split.hint: Paid days come out of their leave balance. Days beyond it are unpaid (LWP), so that month’s salary is lower. The split is set when they apply.

askMaya.question: What is leave without pay (LWP), when does leave become unpaid, and how does it reduce an employee’s salary?

balance_after.hint: Their balance once you approve. A policy may allow a few extra days below zero, paid back from leave added later; beyond that, approval is refused.

askMaya.question: Can a leave balance go below zero, how are the extra days paid back, and what happens when a request needs more days than allowed?

payroll.team_salary.description: Team pay aggregates — Employee Salaries › Total CTC / Average CTC tiles (team_ctc_total, team_ctc_average).

team_ctc_total.hint: The yearly cost of everyone who reports to you, added up — not what they’re paid. It shows even when individual pay is hidden.

askMaya.question: What is CTC (cost to company), and what is the difference between CTC, gross pay and take-home pay?

payroll.pay_days.description: Loss-of-pay days wherever they appear for someone else’s pay — manager Payslips, the team run summary and Payroll Reports (shared with HR).

lop_days.hint: Loss of pay: days in the month the person isn’t paid for, such as unpaid leave or unrecorded absences. They lower that month’s pay.

askMaya.question: What are loss of pay (LOP) days, what causes them, and how are they deducted from salary?

payroll.reports.description: PayrollReportsView column headers, wired by column key — shared by HR Payroll Reports and the manager’s team reports. The config chooses which columns get help.

ctc_cost.hint: Gross pay plus what the company pays on top, such as its PF and ESI share. It’s the full cost of employing them.

askMaya.question: What does cost to company include beyond gross salary, and what are employer PF and ESI contributions?

total_employer_contributions.hint: PF, ESI and related charges the company pays on top of salary. They’re never deducted from the employee’s pay.

askMaya.question: What are employer contributions to PF and ESI, how are they calculated, and why are they not deducted from the employee’s salary?

payroll.salary_structure.description: SalaryStructurePanel component table — Team › member › Salary and Employee Salaries history for managers; an employee’s Salary tab for HR. calculation_basis is the “How it’s worked out” column (calculation_type + value).

calculation_basis.hint: A fixed amount, or a percentage of CTC, basic or gross pay. “Auto (remainder)” takes whatever is left so the parts add up to the CTC.

askMaya.question: How are salary components calculated — as a fixed amount, a percentage of basic or CTC, or a balancing amount — and why is one part the remainder?

documents.team_compliance.description: Manager Document Compliance — the “Where they’re at” column (compliance_state) for a report’s company documents.

compliance_state.hint: Waiting: still to read, acknowledge or sign. Overdue: the due date has passed. Excused: HR let them off. You can remind them; only they can act.

askMaya.question: What do the document compliance states waiting, overdue and excused mean, and who can acknowledge or sign a company document?

documents.proposals.description: Manager Document Proposals — the outcome tiles marked “(this page)”, counted from the rows loaded on the current page.

outcome_counts.hint: These count only the proposals loaded on this page, not all of them. Move through the pages to see the rest.

askMaya.question: What do the proposal counts on this page include, and how do I see all proposals?

documents.letter_bulk.description: HR — Send a letter to many people (BulkIssueLettersDialog, #143). The subject list is the one field with a rule that isn't visible on screen.

subject_user_ids.hint: A batch goes out whole or not at all: if one person can’t be sent this letter, nobody is, and you’re told who to take out.

askMaya.question: When I send one letter to many people at once, what happens if some of them can’t be sent it, and does anyone ever get two copies?

documents.letter_settings.description: HR — Document Settings, the letters-to-many card (#91–#94) and the Phase 5 limits (#95 retention, #96 the hourly batch allowance). Auto-issue on exit and retention both act with nobody watching. Phase 5 (onboarding tier) widens this surface to the whole Document Settings page: `page` beside the h1, plus the number settings whose label alone doesn’t say what they change (link lifetimes, onboarding target, background publish, preview cap), wired through numberField’s `help`.

letter_auto_issue_on_exit.hint: Letters listed here are issued to a leaver on their last working day, with nobody reviewing them first. Leave it empty and nothing is automatic.

askMaya.question: What does issuing letters automatically when someone leaves actually do, and which kinds of letter can never be issued that way?

letter_bulk_rate_per_hour.hint: Past this many batches in an hour, the next person to send one is asked to wait. It guards against the same batch being sent over and over.

askMaya.question: Why is there a limit on how many letter batches can be sent in an hour?

letter_record_retention_days.hint: How long a deleted letter is kept before it is destroyed for good. Lowering it destroys older ones on the next overnight run, and nothing undoes that.

askMaya.question: How long do we have to keep employment letters after deleting them, and which ones can never be destroyed even when the retention period has passed?

page.hint: Rules for documents across the whole organisation: who sees what, who checks uploads, reminder emails, and how letters are numbered and sent.

askMaya.question: What do the organisation-wide document settings control in HR Clouds?

document_view_url_ttl_seconds.hint: How long the link behind a View or Download button works. Short keeps a copied link from being passed around; too short and slow connections fail.

askMaya.question: Why do links to view or download a document expire, and how long should they last?

document_upload_url_ttl_seconds.hint: How long someone has to finish an upload once it starts. Raise it if people on slow connections see their uploads fail.

askMaya.question: Why does an upload link have a time limit, and when should it be raised?

document_onboarding_completeness_thresho.hint: The share of their required documents a person must have provided to count as fully onboarded. Below it, they show as incomplete.

askMaya.question: What is the onboarding completeness target for documents, and how is it measured?

document_publish_sync_threshold.hint: A company document sent to more people than this is published in the background, so HR can carry on working. Smaller ones finish straight away.

askMaya.question: Why are company documents sent to many people published in the background?

letter_preview_rate_per_hour.hint: Past this many letter previews in an hour, the next preview is refused until the hour passes. It stops the preview service being flooded.

askMaya.question: Why is there an hourly limit on letter previews?

payroll.component_setup.description: HR — Setup › Salary Components, the create/edit component dialog. The behavioural flags decide how every structure built from this component behaves; none of them is explained on screen. Phase 5 (onboarding tier): `page` (beside the h1), `bootstrap` (beside the Bootstrap Defaults button, never inside it) and `flags` (the list’s Flags column) are concept keys; the rest are the component payload keys, wired in the dialog, the list headers and the record inspector.

calculation_type.hint: How the amount is worked out: a fixed sum, a share of basic, gross or CTC, or the balancing line that absorbs whatever the others leave over.

askMaya.question: In a salary structure, what do flat amount, percentage of basic, percentage of gross, percentage of CTC and a balancing component mean, and when is each one used?

is_basic.hint: Marks this as the basic pay the rest builds on — PF and every percentage-of-basic component are worked out from it. Only one component can be it.

askMaya.question: Why does basic salary matter in an Indian salary structure, and which deductions and allowances are calculated as a percentage of basic?

is_part_of_ctc.hint: Counts this inside the CTC on the employee’s offer. Switch it off and it is paid on top, so the yearly cost runs above the figure they were given.

askMaya.question: What does CTC include, and how is it different from gross salary and from what reaches the bank?

pf_applicable.hint: Adds this component to the wages PF is worked out on, so switching it on raises both the employee’s deduction and the employer’s share.

askMaya.question: Which salary components count towards PF wages, and how are the employee and employer PF contributions worked out?

page.hint: Components are the lines a salary is built from — basic, allowances, deductions. Structure Templates combine them into a full salary.

askMaya.question: What are salary components, and how are they combined into a salary structure?

bootstrap.hint: Adds the standard components — basic, HRA, special allowance, PF and more — that aren’t set up yet. It never changes existing ones, so it is safe to run twice.

askMaya.question: What are the standard salary components in an Indian salary, and what is each one for?

component_type.hint: Earnings add to pay, deductions come off it, employer contributions are paid by the company on top, and reimbursements pay back money spent for work.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between earnings, deductions, employer contributions and reimbursements in a salary?

is_taxable.hint: On, this line counts as income and income tax is worked out on it. Switch it off only for pay the tax rules treat as exempt.

askMaya.question: Which parts of a salary are taxable in India, and which allowances can be tax-free?

is_lop_applicable.hint: On, this line shrinks when someone has unpaid days in the month. Off, it is paid in full however many days are unpaid.

askMaya.question: Which salary components should be reduced for unpaid days, and which usually stay fixed?

is_prorated_on_joining.hint: On, someone who joins part-way through a month gets this line for the days since joining. Off, they get the whole month’s amount.

askMaya.question: How is salary worked out for someone who joins part-way through a month?

esi_applicable.hint: Adds this line to the wages ESI is worked out on, so for people ESI covers it raises both their deduction and the company’s share.

askMaya.question: Which salary components count towards ESI wages, and how are the employee and employer ESI contributions worked out?

flags.hint: Tags for how the line behaves: BASIC is the basic pay, CTC counts inside the CTC, TAX is taxed, PF counts for PF. Open a row for the full list.

askMaya.question: What do the basic, CTC, taxable and PF flags on a salary component mean?

payroll.statutory_config.description: HR — Setup › Tax & Legal Deductions (TaxConfigurationsPage), the PF / ESI / PT / TDS rate cards. Rendered from the FIELD_GROUPS descriptors, so each help is attached to the descriptor, not the markup. Hints carry no rates or limits — those change with the law. Phase 5 (onboarding tier): every rate and switch in CONFIG_GROUPS (config-only — the descriptor renderer already wires by f.key), each group heading keyed by its toggle key (pf_enabled…), and the tab strip keyed `tab.config` / `tab.pt` / `tab.regimes` (one ⓘ beside the tabs, following the active one). Still no rates or limits in any hint.

pf_wage_ceiling.hint: The most of a month’s wages PF is worked out on. It only bites when the setting below is on; otherwise PF follows the full PF wage.

askMaya.question: What is the PF wage ceiling, and what changes for an employee when the employer restricts PF to the ceiling instead of actual wages?

pf_restrict_to_ceiling.hint: On, PF stops at the ceiling for everyone earning above it. Off, it follows their full PF wage — more saved for them, more cost for the company.

askMaya.question: Should PF be worked out on the full salary or capped at the wage ceiling, and what does each choice cost?

esi_wage_threshold.hint: Earn up to this in a month and ESI is deducted. Cross it and cover runs to the end of the contribution period before it stops, not straight away.

askMaya.question: Who is covered by ESI, and what happens when an employee’s salary rises above the ESI limit part-way through the year?

tds_no_pan_rate.hint: The higher rate income tax is cut at while someone has no PAN on file. Adding their PAN puts them back on the normal slab from the next payroll.

askMaya.question: Why is income tax deducted at a higher rate when an employee has not given their PAN, and what happens once the PAN is provided?

tab.config.hint: The rates and limits for PF, pension, ESI and income tax that every payroll run uses. Change them only when the law or the company’s choice changes.

askMaya.question: What statutory deductions does an Indian employer have to set up for payroll?

tab.pt.hint: Professional tax is a small monthly tax each state sets by salary band. Add the slabs for every state people work in, or nobody there has it deducted.

askMaya.question: How do professional tax slabs work, and why are they different in each state?

tab.regimes.hint: The two sets of income tax rules employees choose between. Each has its own slabs and allowances; the default one applies until someone chooses.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between the old and new income tax regimes for salaried employees?

pf_enabled.hint: Switches PF on for the organisation. Off, no PF is taken from anyone or paid by the company — right only for a company the PF law doesn’t cover.

askMaya.question: Which companies must register for Provident Fund in India, and which employees does it cover?

pf_employee_rate.hint: The share of PF wages taken from the employee’s pay into their PF savings each month. The company adds its own share on top.

askMaya.question: What is Provident Fund, and how are the employee and employer shares worked out?

pf_employer_rate.hint: The share of PF wages the company pays on top of salary. Part of it goes to the employee’s pension — see Pension (EPS) below.

askMaya.question: How is the employer’s PF contribution split between the PF account and the pension scheme?

pf_lop_reduces_ceiling.hint: On, a month with unpaid days lowers the wage ceiling in step, so PF is worked out on the smaller month. Off, the full ceiling applies.

askMaya.question: How do unpaid days affect the PF wage ceiling in a month?

pf_include_overtime.hint: On, overtime pay counts in the wages PF is worked out on, raising both the employee’s and the company’s share. Off, it is left out.

askMaya.question: Should overtime pay be included in the wages PF is calculated on?

pf_admin_charge_rate.hint: A charge the company pays the PF office for running the accounts, worked out on PF wages. It is never taken from the employee.

askMaya.question: What are PF administration charges, and who pays them?

pf_admin_charge_min.hint: The least admin charge due in a month, even when the rate works out lower.

askMaya.question: Why is there a minimum PF administration charge each month?

eps_enabled.hint: Sends part of the company’s PF share to a pension for the employee instead of their PF savings. It doesn’t change what they pay.

askMaya.question: What is the Employees’ Pension Scheme, and how does it relate to the employer’s PF share?

eps_rate.hint: How much of the company’s PF share goes to the employee’s pension rather than their PF savings.

askMaya.question: What is the Employees’ Pension Scheme (EPS), and how is it funded from PF?

eps_wage_ceiling.hint: The most of a month’s wages the pension share is worked out on, however much the person earns.

askMaya.question: What is the pension wage ceiling under EPS, and how does it limit the contribution?

edli_enabled.hint: Life cover for employees that the company pays for through PF. It costs employees nothing; off, no EDLI charge is worked out.

askMaya.question: What is EDLI insurance under PF, and who pays for it?

edli_rate.hint: The company’s EDLI charge, as a share of wages up to the EDLI ceiling beside it.

askMaya.question: How is the EDLI charge worked out, and what cover does it give employees?

esi_enabled.hint: Switches ESI on for the organisation. Off, nobody has ESI taken or paid — right only where the ESI law doesn’t apply.

askMaya.question: What is ESI, which employees does it cover, and what does it give them?

esi_employee_rate.hint: The share of gross pay taken from each person ESI covers, for their medical and sickness cover. The company adds its own share.

askMaya.question: How much ESI is deducted from an employee’s pay, and what benefits does it give them?

esi_employer_rate.hint: The share of gross pay the company pays on top for everyone ESI covers.

askMaya.question: What does the employer contribute towards ESI, and for which employees?

esi_include_overtime.hint: On, overtime pay counts in the wages ESI is worked out on. Off, it is left out.

askMaya.question: Should overtime pay count towards the wages ESI is calculated on?

pt_enabled.hint: On, professional tax is taken each month by the slabs of the employee’s state, set in the next tab. Off, nobody has it deducted.

askMaya.question: What is professional tax in India, and why does it differ from state to state?

income_tax_enabled.hint: On, income tax is worked out and taken from pay every month. Off, none is taken — the tax is then left for employees to pay themselves.

askMaya.question: What is TDS on salary, and why does the employer deduct income tax every month?

tds_no_pan_enforced.hint: On, anyone with no PAN on file has income tax cut at the higher no-PAN rate. Off, the normal slabs are used even without a PAN.

askMaya.question: Why is income tax deducted at a higher rate when an employee has no PAN on file?

cess_rate.hint: An extra charge added on top of the income tax itself, set by law for health and education. Change it only when the law does.

askMaya.question: What is the health and education cess on income tax?

payroll.settings.description: HR — Setup › Payroll Settings. Almost every switch on this screen already carries its own explanation line, so only the unpaid-day divisor is helped here. Phase 5 (onboarding tier): `page` beside the h1, rounding, the two approval switches whose own lines use jargon (Tier A/B, segregation of duties), short-notice recovery and its rate basis (once, on the first of the three rate-basis selects), and the leave types paid out at exit. Section titles sit inside fold buttons, so they get none.

lop_basis.hint: Sets what one unpaid day costs: the month’s pay split over 30 days, over that month’s days, or over its working days. Working days make a day dearest.

askMaya.question: How is one day’s pay worked out when an employee has unpaid days in a month, and why do companies divide the monthly salary differently?

page.hint: Rules for the whole organisation: how unpaid days and rounding are worked out, who approves what, when payslips go out, and how a leaver’s last pay is settled.

askMaya.question: What do the organisation-wide payroll settings control in HR Clouds?

rounding_policy.hint: How each amount is rounded. Nearest rupee drops the paise from every line; two decimals keeps them, so payslips show exact amounts.

askMaya.question: How should salary amounts be rounded on payslips, and what are the trade-offs?

manager_direct_compensation_authority.hint: On, a salary change or bonus a manager proposes applies straight away, with no HR check. Off, HR approves each one first.

askMaya.question: Should managers be able to change pay without HR approval, and what are the risks?

payroll_require_separate_checker.hint: On, the HR admin who proposes a change can’t also approve it — a second HR admin must. With only one HR admin, those changes can’t be approved.

askMaya.question: What is a maker-checker rule in payroll, and why do companies use it?

fnf_notice_recovery_enabled.hint: Someone who leaves before serving their full notice has pay for the days short taken from their final payment. Off, nothing is taken.

askMaya.question: What is notice pay recovery, and how is it taken from a leaver’s final settlement?

fnf_notice_recovery_rate_basis.hint: A day’s pay is worked out from basic or gross salary. Gross gives the higher daily rate, so more is recovered or paid out per day.

askMaya.question: Should a day’s pay for notice recovery or leave payout be worked out from basic or gross salary?

fnf_encashment_leave_type_codes.hint: Only the leave types listed here are paid out when someone leaves; their other balances are not. Use the codes set in Leave Types.

askMaya.question: Which kinds of leave are usually paid out when an employee leaves?

leaves.policy_setup.description: HR — Setup › Leave Policies, the leave-quota dialog inside a policy. The quota, accrual and probation fields already carry their own lines on screen; these three do not say what happens afterwards. Phase 5 (onboarding tier): `page` beside the h1 and the yearly quota, wired in the quota dialog and the quota table headers. How leave is given and the joining wait carry their own lines.

max_carry_forward.hint: The most unused days that move into next year. Anything above it is lost when the year closes, unless the leave is paid out instead.

askMaya.question: What does carrying leave forward to the next year mean, and what usually happens to unused days above the limit?

max_negative_balance.hint: How far past zero someone may go on this leave. Days taken below zero come back out of a later quota, or off their final pay if they leave first.

askMaya.question: What does allowing leave below zero mean, and how are those days recovered?

notice_period_max_days.hint: What happens to this leave once somebody has resigned — no limit, none allowed at all, or a set number of days across the whole notice period.

askMaya.question: How is leave usually handled during an employee’s notice period?

page.hint: A policy bundles leave quotas: how many days of each leave type, and how they are given. Assign one to each person from here; their balances come from it.

askMaya.question: What is a leave policy, and how does it decide each employee’s leave balances?

annual_quota.hint: Days of this leave each person on the policy gets in a full year. Someone who joins part-way through gets days worked out from their joining date.

askMaya.question: How is annual leave worked out for an employee who joins part-way through the year?

attendance.policy_setup.description: HR — Setup › Attendance Policies, the policy dialog. Nearly every field there carries its own range line, so only the two that decide whether a day is paid are helped. Phase 5 (onboarding tier): every rule a first-month HR admin could misread, wired in the dialog, the policy record inspector and the list headers by the same keys. `page` is the page-level concept key beside the h1. late_threshold_minutes and consecutive_late_penalty_days are left out on purpose: what they do is unsettled (ATTENDANCE_MODULE_AUDIT C4).

half_day_min_hours.hint: Work less than this on a working day and it counts as absent rather than a half day, so the day is unpaid unless leave or a correction covers it.

askMaya.question: How do effective working hours decide whether a day counts as a full day, a half day or absent, and what happens to pay for a half day?

missing_punch_action.hint: What happens to a day somebody never clocked out of: hold it for review, treat it as a half day, or mark it absent — which makes it unpaid.

askMaya.question: What should happen to a day when an employee forgets to clock out?

page.hint: The rule book that judges each day: on time or late, full day, half day or absent, and overtime. Each shift uses one; shifts with none use the default.

askMaya.question: What is an attendance policy, and how does it decide late, half day, absent and overtime?

is_default.hint: Any shift with no policy of its own uses this one. Only one policy can be the default, so switching it on here takes it off the current default.

askMaya.question: What does the default attendance policy do, and when is it used?

grace_minutes.hint: Minutes after the shift starts that someone can still clock in and not be marked late. With 10, a 9:08 clock-in for a 9:00 shift is on time.

askMaya.question: What is a grace period for late arrival, and how long do companies usually allow?

early_exit_threshold_minutes.hint: How much earlier than the shift end someone can leave before the day is recorded as an early exit. Leaving within it is not flagged.

askMaya.question: How is leaving early recorded against a shift, and what does the early-exit threshold change?

full_day_min_hours.hint: Hours actually worked, breaks left out, that make a full day. Between this and the half-day hours it is a half day; below both, the day is absent.

askMaya.question: How do working hours decide whether a day is a full day, a half day or absent?

late_count_half_day_threshold.hint: How many late arrivals add up to one half day being counted. Leave it empty and being late never turns into a half day.

askMaya.question: How do repeated late arrivals turn into a half day, and why do companies use this rule?

auto_clock_out_enabled.hint: Closes a day nobody clocked out of, the set number of hours after clock-in. Off, that day is handled by the missing-punch rule beside it.

askMaya.question: What does automatic clock-out do for days nobody clocked out of?

auto_detect_shift.hint: For anyone with no shift on a day, the shift nearest their clock-in is used, so lateness and hours are judged against it.

askMaya.question: How does automatic shift detection work for people with no shift assigned?

overtime_enabled.hint: Records time worked past what a full day needs as overtime. Off, extra hours on this policy are not recorded as overtime at all.

askMaya.question: How is overtime recorded and worked out from attendance?

overtime_min_minutes.hint: The least extra time that counts as overtime. Anything shorter is dropped, so a few minutes past the full day don’t become overtime.

askMaya.question: Why is there a minimum amount of extra time before overtime counts?

overtime_requires_approval.hint: On, a manager has to approve overtime before it counts towards pay. Off, it is approved automatically when the day ends.

askMaya.question: Should overtime need a manager’s approval before it is paid?

regularization_allowed.hint: Lets people ask for a missed or wrong punch to be fixed; their manager or HR decides. Off, a wrong day stays as recorded — pay included.

askMaya.question: What is an attendance correction, and how does the approval work?

comp_off_on_holiday_work.hint: Working a holiday or weekly off earns earned leave — a day off given back. How much is earned and when it expires is set in Earned Leave Policies.

askMaya.question: What is compensatory leave for working on a holiday or weekly off, and how is it earned?

attendance.comp_off_policy.description: HR — Setup › Comp-off Policies. The hours, multiplier, priority and cap fields all carry their own lines; expiry is the one rule that quietly takes earned time off away. Phase 5 (onboarding tier): `page` beside the page title, plus priority, the full-day hours and the multiplier, wired in the dialog, list headers and record inspector. Half-day hours, cap and approval carry their own lines.

validity_days.hint: How long a credited day stays usable. Once it passes, the day is gone — it is not paid out — so a short window can waste time people have already worked.

askMaya.question: How long should earned leave for working on an off day stay usable before it expires?

page.hint: Earned leave is a day off given back for working a holiday or weekly off. These policies set how much is earned, how long it lasts and who it covers.

askMaya.question: What is earned leave for working on holidays or weekly offs, and how is it credited?

priority.hint: Someone two policies cover is credited under the one with the higher number only. Give a narrower group’s policy a higher number.

askMaya.question: What happens when more than one earned-leave policy covers the same employee?

min_hours_for_full_day.hint: Hours worked on a holiday or weekly off to earn a full day back. Between the half-day and full-day hours, half a day is earned; below, none.

askMaya.question: How many hours of work on an off day earn a full or half day of earned leave?

multiplier.hint: How many days off each day earned is worth. 1 gives a day for a day; 2 gives two days back for every day worked.

askMaya.question: What does an earned-leave multiplier mean, and when would a company use more than one day for one?

payroll.structure_template.description: HR — Setup › Structure Templates: the template dialog and its Add Component row. Both fields are named after the engine, not after what they do. Phase 5 (onboarding tier): `page` beside the h1 and `target_ctc`, the Manage Components planning strip (CtcBudgetBar). The preview dialog reuses payroll.salary_revision.annual_ctc and this surface’s calculation_type.

definition_mode.hint: Start from a yearly CTC and split it into components, or add components up to whatever total they reach. CTC-driven needs a balancing component.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between building a salary structure from a total CTC downwards and building it up from individual components?

calculation_type.hint: How this line is worked out inside the template: a fixed sum, a share of basic, gross or CTC, or the balancing line that takes up whatever is left.

askMaya.question: In a salary template, what do flat amount, percentage of basic, gross or CTC, and balancing mean?

page.hint: A template is a ready-made salary shape: which components, and how each is worked out. Assign it with a CTC on Employee Salaries and the split follows.

askMaya.question: What is a salary structure template, and how does it split a CTC into components?

target_ctc.hint: A sample yearly CTC to plan with. It shows how the lines add up and what the balancing line would fill — it is not saved to anyone’s salary.

askMaya.question: How does a salary template split a yearly CTC, and what does the balancing component fill?

payroll.bonus_rule.description: HR — Setup › Bonus Rules, the rule dialog. The percentage note already explains the base it uses; this covers the choice above it. Phase 5 (onboarding tier): `page` beside the h1, the pay month, minimum time with us and `total_gross` (preview stat, concept key); list headers and the inspector reuse these keys and bonus_type.

bonus_type.hint: Whether everyone who qualifies gets the same amount, or a share of their own salary. It decides what the field beside it means.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between a flat bonus and a bonus worked out as a percentage of salary?

page.hint: Pays one bonus to a whole group at once. Preview what it costs, have it approved, then apply it to add it to that month’s pay for everyone who qualifies.

askMaya.question: How does a bonus rule pay a bonus to a group of employees at once?

period_month.hint: The pay month the bonus is added to. Each person gets it as its own line on that month’s payslip.

askMaya.question: How does a bonus show on the payslip of the month it is paid in, and how is it taxed?

min_tenure_months.hint: People who joined fewer than this many months ago are left out of this bonus. Leave it empty and anyone can qualify.

askMaya.question: Why do bonus rules often require a minimum time with the company?

total_gross.hint: Every bonus added up before tax and other deductions — what the company pays out, not what reaches people’s bank accounts.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between a gross bonus and what an employee actually receives after tax?

payroll.benefit_plan.description: HR — Setup › Benefit Plans, the Advanced block of the plan dialog. Which component the money is taken through decides how it shows on the payslip. Phase 5 (onboarding tier): `page` beside the h1, the two monthly amounts (dialog labels and list headers), sum insured and the company component. Overrides, dates and the end-cover dialog explain themselves.

employee_component_id.hint: The deduction line the employee’s share is charged through, so it is what they see on their payslip. Left empty, payroll picks a component itself.

askMaya.question: How does an employee’s share of a benefit plan appear on their payslip?

page.hint: Extras such as health insurance. Once someone is enrolled, each month their share comes off their pay and the company’s share is added to its costs.

askMaya.question: What are employee benefit plans such as group health insurance, and how are they paid for?

employee_contribution_amount.hint: Taken from each enrolled person’s pay every month, as a deduction line on their payslip. 0 means the company covers all of it.

askMaya.question: How is an employee’s monthly share of a benefit plan deducted from salary?

employer_contribution_amount.hint: What the company pays each month for every enrolled person. It adds to what employing them costs; it is not paid to them.

askMaya.question: How does the employer’s share of a benefit plan count towards the cost of employing someone?

coverage_amount.hint: The most the insurance pays out under this plan, kept for reference. What people pay each month is set by the two amounts beside it.

askMaya.question: What is the sum insured in a group insurance plan?

employer_component_id.hint: The line the company’s share is recorded under as a company cost. Left empty, payroll picks a component itself.

askMaya.question: How is the employer’s share of a benefit plan recorded in payroll?

payroll.run_item.description: HR — Payroll Runs › a run › one employee's record inspector (PayrollRunDetailPage). Derived figures the engine produced; the run's own status already carries a hint line, so it gets none. Phase 5 (onboarding tier): the rest of the per-employee inspector (gross, net, days paid, unpaid-day deduction, shortfall recovered, ESI wage, taxable earnings, ESI cover, and the line tables’ `source` / `full_month_amount` columns — on the Earnings table only, once per dialog), plus the run page’s gross/net tiles and two concept keys on its employee table: `item_status` (Status header) and `days_paid_unpaid`.

ctc_cost.hint: What this person costs the company this month — their pay plus the employer’s share of PF, ESI and benefits. It is not what they receive.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between cost to company, gross pay and what reaches an employee’s bank account?

lop_divisor.hint: The number of days this month’s pay was split over to price one unpaid day. It follows the unpaid-day rule set in Payroll Settings.

askMaya.question: How is one day’s pay worked out when an employee has unpaid days in a month?

carry_forward_out.hint: A deduction there wasn’t enough pay left to take this month. It is carried over and taken from a later payroll instead of being written off.

askMaya.question: What happens to a deduction when there isn’t enough pay left to take it in a month?

pf_wage.hint: The part of this month’s pay PF was worked out on — only the components marked PF-applicable, capped at the ceiling if that setting is on.

askMaya.question: Which parts of a salary count as PF wages, and why is PF often worked out on less than the gross salary?

gross_earnings.hint: Everything earned this month before deductions — not take-home. Reimbursements are paid on top and aren’t part of it.

askMaya.question: What is gross pay, and how is it different from net pay and CTC?

net_pay.hint: What reaches the bank: gross pay less deductions, plus any reimbursements paid on top.

askMaya.question: How is net pay worked out from gross pay, deductions and reimbursements?

payable_days.hint: The days this month the person is paid for — the month’s days less their unpaid days.

askMaya.question: What are payable days in payroll, and how do unpaid days reduce them?

lop_amount.hint: What unpaid days took off this month’s pay: one day’s pay times the number of unpaid days.

askMaya.question: How is the deduction for unpaid days worked out from a month’s salary?

carry_forward_in.hint: A deduction left over from an earlier month, when pay ran out, taken from this month’s pay instead.

askMaya.question: How is a deduction carried over from an earlier month recovered from salary?

esi_wage.hint: The part of this month’s pay ESI is worked out on — only the lines marked as counting for ESI.

askMaya.question: Which parts of salary count as wages for ESI?

taxable_earnings.hint: This month’s pay that counts as income for income tax — only the lines marked taxable.

askMaya.question: Which parts of a month’s salary count as taxable income?

esi_covered.hint: Yes when this person earns within the ESI limit, so ESI is taken from their pay and the company pays its share too.

askMaya.question: Who is covered by ESI, and how is it decided each contribution period?

source.hint: Where the line comes from: the salary structure, a one-off adjustment, overtime, a loan, a benefit or a deduction required by law.

askMaya.question: Where can the lines on a payslip come from — salary structure, adjustments, loans, benefits or statutory deductions?

full_month_amount.hint: What the line would be for a whole month. This month’s figure is lower when unpaid days or joining mid-month cut it.

askMaya.question: Why can a salary component be lower than its full-month amount on a payslip?

item_status.hint: Calculated: pay worked out. Needs attention: a problem stopped it. Excluded: left out of this run. Waiting: not calculated yet.

askMaya.question: Why might an employee be excluded from a payroll run or need attention before approval?

days_paid_unpaid.hint: Days paid for this month, then days not paid for — unpaid leave or absences. Unpaid days lower that month’s pay.

askMaya.question: How do paid and unpaid days in a month affect salary?

payroll.arrears.description: HR — Payroll › Pay Differences (PayrollArrearsPage, API #203–#205). The difference column is the whole screen; its mechanism is in the file header and nowhere on screen. Phase 5 (onboarding tier): `page` beside the h1.

net_delta.hint: What the month would work out to now, less what was already paid. Paying it adds the difference to the next open month; the old payslip is never rewritten.

askMaya.question: What is backdated pay in payroll, and why is it paid in a later month instead of correcting the original payslip?

page.hint: Backdated pay. When a past raise or an attendance fix changes a month already paid, the difference is paid later; old payslips stay as they were.

askMaya.question: What is arrears or backdated pay, and how is it paid when a salary revision is dated in the past?

payroll.bank_verification.description: HR — Payroll › Bank Verification. What verifying an account actually certifies. The self-verify guard in verifyAction() already explains itself when it bites; this covers the column for everyone else.

is_verified.hint: Verified means a second person checked the details against a passbook or cheque. It is not a check with the bank, and nobody may clear their own account.

askMaya.question: Why should an employee’s bank details be verified before salary is paid, and how is it done?

payroll.tax_verification.description: HR — Tax › Tax Declarations, the verification dialog. The employee-facing payroll.tax_declaration entries are written to the employee about their own proof, so they must not be reused here (§2 voice rule). Phase 5 (onboarding tier): `page` beside the Tax Declarations h1, `proof_deadline` on the list header and inspector, `section` on the items table (payroll.tax_declaration.section is written to the employee).

verified_amount.hint: The amount you accept is what lowers their tax for the rest of the year. Accept less than they declared and more income tax comes out of their next payslips.

askMaya.question: How does verifying an investment declaration change the income tax deducted from an employee’s salary for the rest of the financial year?

page.hint: Employees declare savings and rent so less income tax is taken each month. HR checks each proof; only what HR accepts lowers their tax.

askMaya.question: How do employee tax-saving declarations work, and how does HR verify the proofs?

proof_deadline.hint: The last day to upload proof. Anything still unverified after it stops counting, so income tax jumps in the next payslips.

askMaya.question: What is the investment proof deadline for income tax declarations, and what happens if proofs are not submitted in time?

section.hint: The part of the income-tax law each saving falls under — such as 80C or 80D. It decides how much of the amount can lower tax.

askMaya.question: What are the common income tax deduction sections such as 80C, 80D and HRA, and what does each cover?

organization.invite.description: HR — People › Invites, the invite dialog (InviteMemberModal). The role decides what the person can see of everyone else, and nothing on the form says so. Phase 5 (onboarding tier): the invite dialog’s employee code, head-of-department, job status, employment type, joining date, PAN and UAN, and `status` on the Invites list’s Status column.

role.hint: What they will see: an employee only their own records, a manager their team’s as well, and an HR admin the whole organisation — pay included.

askMaya.question: What can an employee, a manager and an HR admin each see and do in HR Clouds?

employee_code.hint: The company’s own staff number for this person, shown beside their name where an identifier helps. Leave it empty if the company doesn’t use one.

askMaya.question: What is an employee code, and how do companies usually number their staff?

is_hod.hint: Makes this person the head of the department. Employees in it then report to them unless someone else is chosen.

askMaya.question: What does a head of department do in HR Clouds, and who reports to them?

job_status.hint: Where they are in their employment — probation, confirmed, notice period. Leave, weekly-off and document rules can be aimed at a status.

askMaya.question: What do job statuses such as probation, confirmed and notice period mean for an employee?

employment_type.hint: Full time, part time, contract or intern. Weekly-off, earned leave and document rules can be aimed at a type.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between full-time, part-time, contract and intern employment?

joining_date.hint: Their first day. Leave for the first year and pay for the first month are worked out from it, so use the real date.

askMaya.question: How does an employee’s joining date affect their first month’s pay and their leave?

pan_number.hint: The person’s income-tax number. Until it’s on file, their income tax is cut at a higher rate.

askMaya.question: What is a PAN, and why does an employer need an employee’s PAN for salary?

uan_number.hint: Their PF account number, kept for life across jobs. Add it if they had PF with an earlier employer, so savings stay in one account.

askMaya.question: What is a UAN in Provident Fund, and what happens when an employee already has one from a previous job?

status.hint: Waiting: sent, not accepted yet. Expired: not accepted within 48 hours — invite them again. Revoked: the link was cancelled.

askMaya.question: What happens when an invitation expires or is revoked, and how do I invite someone again?

payroll.year_end.description: HR — Tax › Year-End & Form 16, the employee dialog. payroll.form16 is written to the employee about their own certificate, so it is not reused here (§2 voice rule). The hint asserts only what the same screen shows: provisional goes with a year that is still open. Phase 5 (onboarding tier): `page` beside the h1 — what finalizing freezes (from the finalize dialog’s own text).

is_provisional.hint: Provisional means this was worked out from a year that is still open, so the figures can change until the year is closed for that employee.

askMaya.question: What does a provisional Form 16 mean, and when does it become final?

statutory_summary.hint: What was deducted for PF, ESI, professional tax and TDS each month, to prepare the payments. It isn’t a return you can upload for filing.

askMaya.question: What is a statutory challan, and how is it different from a PF ECR, an ESI return and a 24Q TDS return?

page.hint: Finalizing a year freezes everyone’s tax records and Form 16 for it. Their regime, earlier-employer pay and declarations can’t be changed after.

askMaya.question: What happens at financial year-end closing in payroll, and what gets frozen?

payroll.adjustment_admin.description: HR — Payroll › Salary Adjustments, the fields the manager's proposal form does not have. The type, component and pay month come from payroll.adjustment_proposal, which HR now shares (§2). Phase 5 (onboarding tier): `page` beside the h1, `tax_flags` on the Tax & contributions legend, and `applied` (the ‘In an approved payroll’ line of the record inspector). List headers and the inspector’s stats reuse payroll.adjustment_proposal and this surface’s category.

category.hint: Groups this line for reports and payslips. It does not change the amount or the tax — pick the one that describes why the money is moving.

askMaya.question: What are the categories of one-off salary adjustments used for?

page.hint: One-off money added to or taken from one person’s pay for a single month — a bonus, a refund, a recovery. It shows as its own line on that month’s payslip.

askMaya.question: What are one-off salary adjustments, and how do they appear on a payslip?

tax_flags.hint: Whether this amount is taxed and counts towards PF and ESI. A line picked from a component takes these from it; a custom line sets them here.

askMaya.question: How is a one-off salary addition taxed, and does it count towards PF and ESI?

applied.hint: Yes once a payroll that includes it has been approved. From then on it can’t be changed — cancel that payroll run first if it’s wrong.

askMaya.question: Why can’t a salary adjustment be changed once its payroll is approved?

payroll.encashment_admin.description: HR — Payroll › Leave Payouts, the pay-out dialog. payroll.encashment_proposal says “once HR approves it”, which is wrong when HR is the one filling the form, so the month gets its own entry here (§2 voice rule). Phase 5 (onboarding tier): `page` beside the h1, the leave-type code and the daily rate in the inspector. The payout amount’s basis stays unstated (audit §11.4).

period_month.hint: The pay month the payout lands in. It has to be a month whose payroll is not approved or paid yet, or there is nothing left to add it to.

askMaya.question: Which pay month can a leave payout be added to, and why must it still be open?

page.hint: Pays people for earned or unused leave instead of the time off. Approving takes the days off their balance and adds the money to the chosen pay month.

askMaya.question: What is a leave payout, and how is unused or earned leave paid out as money?

leave_type_code.hint: The code of the leave being paid out, as set in Leave Types — for example EL. The days come off that leave’s balance.

askMaya.question: Which kinds of leave can be paid out, and what happens to the leave balance?

per_day_amount.hint: One day’s pay used for this payout. The amount is the number of days paid out multiplied by this rate.

askMaya.question: How is one day’s pay worked out for a leave payout?

payroll.structure_assign.description: HR — Payroll › Employee Salaries, the assign/revise dialog. The CTC, effective date and revision type come from payroll.salary_revision, which HR now shares; the template picker is HR-only. Phase 5 (onboarding tier): `page` beside the h1; `version` in the salary-history inspector; `employer_statutory` on the ‘Cost to the company’ stage of CtcMoneyFlow (concept key — the employer PF/EDLI/admin/ESI group). The list headers and history stats reuse payroll.salary_revision.

template_id.hint: The template decides how the yearly CTC is split into basic, allowances and deductions. Changing it later rebuilds the whole structure.

askMaya.question: What is a salary structure template, and how does it decide the split between basic pay, allowances and deductions?

page.hint: Each person’s current salary and every change to it. Assign a salary to someone new, or revise one for a raise, a promotion or a correction.

askMaya.question: How do you assign or revise an employee’s salary structure?

version.hint: Each approved change to this person’s salary makes a new version. The latest one is the salary payroll uses now; older ones are kept as history.

askMaya.question: Why does each salary change create a new version of an employee’s salary?

employer_statutory.hint: What the company must pay by law on top of pay — its PF share, pension, EDLI cover, PF admin and ESI. It comes out of the CTC before gross pay.

askMaya.question: What statutory contributions does an Indian employer pay on top of salary, and why are they included in CTC?

payroll.tax_regime_config.description: HR — Setup › Tax & Legal Deductions › Income-Tax Regimes, the regime cards. Pure tax vocabulary with nothing on screen to explain it. No figures in the hints — every one of these changes with the finance act. Phase 5 (onboarding tier): allows_hra_exemption on the cards and in Edit Params; is_default and age_band in the regime and slab editors. The editors reuse the existing keys for their fields.

standard_deduction.hint: A flat amount taken off salary before tax is worked out. Everyone on this regime gets it — nobody has to declare anything to earn it.

askMaya.question: What is the standard deduction on salary income, and does an employee have to declare anything to claim it?

rebate_87a_income_limit.hint: Total income up to this figure pays no income tax at all, because the rebate cancels what would otherwise be due.

askMaya.question: What is the section 87A rebate, and how does it mean some salaried employees pay no income tax at all?

allows_chapter_via.hint: Whether savings an employee declares — 80C, 80D and the rest — can lower their tax on this regime. Switched off, declaring changes nothing.

askMaya.question: Which tax deductions can be claimed under the old regime but not the new one, and what does Chapter VI-A cover?

allows_hra_exemption.hint: Allowed means rent paid can lower taxable income under this regime, for people whose pay includes house rent allowance.

askMaya.question: How does the HRA exemption lower income tax for someone who pays rent?

is_default.hint: The regime used for anyone who hasn’t chosen one yet. Their income tax is worked out on its slabs until they choose.

askMaya.question: Which income tax regime applies to an employee who hasn’t chosen one?

age_band.hint: Which age group these slabs are for. Older taxpayers can have different slabs, so each age band keeps its own set.

askMaya.question: Why do income tax slabs differ for senior and very senior citizens?

payroll.pt_slabs.description: HR — Setup › Tax & Legal Deductions › Professional Tax Slabs, the per-state slab tables. PT is the one deduction the organisation does not set the rate for. Phase 5 (onboarding tier): `gender` in the slab editor.

amount.hint: Professional tax is charged by the state, not by this organisation. What comes off depends on where the employee works and what they earn.

askMaya.question: What is professional tax, which states charge it, and how is the monthly amount decided for a salaried employee?

gender.hint: Some states charge women a different professional tax. Pick Any when the state charges everyone alike.

askMaya.question: Why do some states charge different professional tax for women?

documents.verification.description: HR — Documents We Collect › Verification Queue. The manager's recommendation is advice; only HR's decision moves the document out of the queue. Phase 5 (onboarding tier): `page` beside the h1 — what verifying certifies.

recommendation.hint: What the employee’s manager advised. It is only advice — the document stays in this queue until you verify or reject it yourself.

askMaya.question: What is a manager’s recommendation on a document, and who makes the final decision?

page.hint: Uploads waiting for HR to check. Verifying says the file is right for that person; only verified documents count towards what they’re required to hold.

askMaya.question: What does verifying an employee’s document mean, and why does it matter?

documents.letter_queue_health.description: HR — Document Automation, the letter render queue readout (#151). Every figure is derived, and the failure rate has a real null.

queued.hint: Letters asked for but not yet produced. They are made in the background, so a few waiting is normal right after a busy moment.

askMaya.question: How are letters produced in the background, and when is a queue a problem?

oldest_queued_age_seconds.hint: How long the letter at the front of the queue has been waiting. A long wait here, not a big number, is what means something is stuck.

askMaya.question: How can I tell whether letter production is stuck?

failure_rate.hint: The share of letters that finished but didn’t come out. It reads N/A when nothing finished — that is no news, not a clean result.

askMaya.question: What does the letter failure rate show, and what should I do if it is high?

payroll.payslip_queue_health.description: HR — Payroll Automation, the payslip render queue readout (#221). The payroll twin of documents.letter_queue_health; same figures, same wording.

queued.hint: Payslips asked for but not yet produced. They are made in the background, so a few waiting is normal right after a busy moment.

askMaya.question: How are payslip PDFs produced in the background, and when is a queue a problem?

oldest_queued_age_seconds.hint: How long the payslip at the front of the queue has been waiting. A long wait here, not a big number, is what means something is stuck.

askMaya.question: How can I tell whether payslip production is stuck?

failure_rate.hint: The share of payslips that finished but didn’t come out. It reads N/A when nothing finished — that is no news, not a clean result.

askMaya.question: What does the payslip failure rate show, and what should I do if it is high?

leaves.assign_policy.description: HR — Assign a leave policy (AssignLeavePolicyDialog), from the employee profile's Leave tab and from the org-wide Leave Requests page. The one destructive action in Leave: it replaces every rule the person has.

template_id.hint: Sets how many days of each kind of leave this person gets. It replaces any rules they already have, and their days are worked out from the day they joined.

askMaya.question: When someone is given a leave policy part-way through the year, how are their leave days worked out, and what happens to days they had already been given?

organization.org_chart.description: Org Chart (OrgChartPage) — stat tiles, and the person dialog (OrgPersonDialog). depth, biggest_team, team_size and level are derived in orgChartMeta.js; reporting_to_id is the hierarchy node key.

depth.hint: How many layers there are from the top of the organisation down to the people furthest from it.

askMaya.question: What does the number of levels in an org chart say about an organisation?

biggest_team.hint: The most people who report directly to one person. People further down their line aren’t counted here.

askMaya.question: What is a span of control, and how many direct reports is usual for one manager?

reporting_to_id.hint: Who this person reports to, all the way up. The manager directly above them is the one who reviews their leave and attendance requests.

askMaya.question: What is a reporting line in a company, and how does the person I report to affect who reviews my leave and attendance requests?

team_size.hint: Everyone below this person on the chart: the people who report to them, the people who report to those people, and so on.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between direct reports and everyone under a person in an org chart?

level.hint: How far down the chart this person sits. Level 1 is the top of the organisation; each step down adds one.

askMaya.question: How are levels counted in an org chart?

organization.company_profile.description: Company Profile (CompanyProfilePage) — the People headline and the HR-only Tax & legal registration card. Keys are GET /organizations/details response keys.

total_active_members.hint: People who have joined and can sign in today. Invitations not yet accepted and people who have left aren’t counted.

askMaya.question: Who counts as an active member of the organisation in HR Clouds?

gst_number.hint: The company’s GST registration number. Suppliers, customers and tax filings use it to identify the business.

askMaya.question: What is a GSTIN, what does each part of the 15-character number mean, and where does a company need to use it?

company_pan_number.hint: The company’s own income-tax number — not any employee’s PAN. It appears on the Form 16 given to employees.

askMaya.question: What is a company PAN, how is it different from a TAN, and where does it appear in salary tax documents like Form 16?

documents.catalog.description: Document Types › Catalog (DocumentTypesPage › CatalogTab) — the ready-made PDF letter filter. letter_template is a concept key: a catalog row paired with a #135 letter template (catalogLetterMeta.js).

letter_template.hint: Types HR Clouds can write for you as a branded PDF. Activate the type here, then switch its letter on under Letter Templates.

askMaya.question: How do ready-made PDF letters work, and how are they switched on?

organization.company_profile_edit.description: Edit company details (EditCompanyProfileDialog, HR only) — keys are PATCH /organizations/profile body keys. Ordinary fields (industry, address, phone, description) carry no hint.

org_name.hint: Renames the organisation everywhere, not just on this page — sign-in, invitation emails and documents all use it.

askMaya.question: Where does the organisation name appear across HR Clouds?

size.hint: A band, not an exact count — the headcount on this page is counted from the people who have joined.

askMaya.question: What is the company size band used for in HR Clouds?

gst_number.hint: The company’s GST registration number. Only HR can see or change it.

askMaya.question: What is a GSTIN, what does each part of the 15-character number mean, and where does a company need to use it?

company_pan_number.hint: The company’s own income-tax number — not any employee’s PAN. It appears on the Form 16 given to employees.

askMaya.question: What is a company PAN, how is it different from a TAN, and where does it appear in salary tax documents like Form 16?

payroll.settlement.description: Final settlement record inspector (PayrollExitsPage › SettlementPanel) — the #224 statement download. Keys name the concept, as the statement has no response key of its own. Phase 5 (onboarding tier): `page` beside the Exits & Final Pay h1, `status` on the Stage column (the recorded → prepared → settled machine from the file header), and `period_month` (the ‘Pay it with’ month) in the settlement inspector.

settlement_statement.hint: Provisional until the final pay goes out in a payroll run: payouts and recoveries only. The final one adds the last month’s pay and what was paid.

askMaya.question: What goes into a full and final settlement, and why can a provisional statement differ from the final one?

page.hint: Record someone leaving, then work out their final pay — last month’s salary, unused leave paid out, short notice and loans recovered — and pay it in a payroll.

askMaya.question: What is a full and final settlement when an employee leaves, and what does it include?

status.hint: Recorded: last day on file, nothing worked out. Prepared: amounts fixed, waiting for a payroll. Settled: paid in an approved run.

askMaya.question: What are the stages of a final settlement, from recording an exit to paying it?

period_month.hint: The payroll month the final payment is added to. Once the settlement is prepared it’s fixed; undo it to change the month.

askMaya.question: Which payroll month should a leaver’s final payment be paid in?

payroll.run_payslips.description: Payslips & delivery panel on a payroll run (RunPayslipsPanel) — the two bank advice files (#181 CSV, #223 PDF).

bank_advice.hint: Upload the CSV to your bank to pay everyone. The PDF is a printable copy to sign and keep on file — account numbers are hidden, so a bank can’t use it.

askMaya.question: What is a bank advice file, and how is it used to pay salaries?

attendance.shift_setup.description: HR — Setup › Work Shifts (AttendanceShiftsPage): the shift and rotation dialogs, both lists and the shift record inspector. Concept keys: `page` (beside the h1), `rotations` (the Rotation Patterns heading). The policy thresholds in the inspector reuse attendance.policy_setup.

page.hint: A shift sets the hours people work. Its linked attendance policy then decides lateness, half days and overtime against those hours.

askMaya.question: What is a work shift, and how does it work with an attendance policy?

type.hint: Fixed has set start and end times. Flexible has none, so nobody on it is marked late. Night starts one day and ends the next.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between fixed, flexible and night shifts?

start_time.hint: Lateness is measured from the start time, after the policy’s grace period, and early exits from the end time. Get these wrong and people are marked late.

askMaya.question: How do shift start and end times decide lateness and early exits?
