policy_id.hint: The rule book this shift is judged by — grace, full and half-day hours, overtime. With none linked, the default attendance policy applies.

askMaya.question: How does a shift’s attendance policy decide late arrivals, half days and overtime?

rotations.hint: A rotation moves people through several shifts on a repeating schedule — say a week of mornings, then a week of nights. Rest days come from Weekly Offs.

askMaya.question: What is a rotating shift pattern, and when do companies use one?

start_reference_date.hint: Day 1 of the first phase. The pattern counts forward from this date and repeats, so it decides which shift falls on every later day.

askMaya.question: How does the start date of a shift rotation decide which shift falls on each day?

entries.hint: Each phase is one shift worked for a run of days. Phases run in this order, then the cycle starts again from the first one.

askMaya.question: How are the phases of a shift rotation set up and repeated?

rotation_cycle_days.hint: How many days the whole pattern takes before it repeats — the phase lengths added together.

askMaya.question: How is the length of a shift rotation cycle worked out?

attendance.weekly_off_setup.description: HR — Setup › Weekly Offs (AttendanceWeeklyOffsPage): the rule dialog, both rule tables and the rule record inspector. Only priority is helped; days, dates and targeting explain themselves on screen.

priority.hint: Someone two rules cover gets only the days off of the rule with the higher number. Give a narrower group’s rule a higher number than the company-wide one.

askMaya.question: What happens when two weekly-off rules cover the same employee?

organization.location_setup.description: HR — Setup › Office Locations (AttendanceLocationsPage), the location dialog. Name and address are ordinary; the two fields attendance reads are helped. Out-of-bounds clock-ins are accepted and flagged (ATTENDANCE_MODULE_AUDIT, Punches).

timezone.hint: The office’s local time zone. Clock-ins here are read in it, so a wrong zone moves everyone’s start time and can mark a whole office late.

askMaya.question: Why does an office location need the right time zone for attendance?

geofence_radius_meters.hint: How far from the pin someone can clock in. Further out, the clock-in still counts but is flagged for review as outside the office.

askMaya.question: What is a clock-in radius, and what happens when someone clocks in outside it?

leaves.type_setup.description: HR — Setup › Leave Types (LeaveTypesPage): the type dialog, the list headers and the type record inspector. `page` sits beside the h1. Name, description, the document threshold and who-can-apply explain themselves.

page.hint: The kinds of leave people can ask for, such as sick or casual leave. How many days each person gets of each is set in Leave Policies, not here.

askMaya.question: What are leave types, and how are they different from leave policies?

code.hint: A short tag for this leave, used where the full name won’t fit — tables, balances and reports. Every leave type needs its own.

askMaya.question: What is a leave code used for?

is_paid.hint: Off makes every day of this leave an unpaid day, taken off that month’s pay. Leave people are given each year is normally paid.

askMaya.question: What is leave without pay, and how do unpaid leave days reduce a month’s salary?

sandwich_rule_applies.hint: On, a weekend that falls between two leave days counts as leave too. Friday and Monday off would then use four days, not two.

askMaya.question: What is the sandwich rule for leave, and why do some companies apply it?

leaves.automation.description: HR — Setup › Leave Automation (LeaveAutomationPage). Concept keys: `page` (beside the h1), `accrual` and `rollover` (the two card titles), `rollover.reference_date` (the rollover card’s date — the same API key as the accrual one, but it picks a year, not a month). `reference_date` is the accrual card’s payload key.

page.hint: Both jobs run by themselves on schedule. Run one here only to catch up after a missed run — each skips anyone it has already handled.

askMaya.question: How do the automatic leave jobs work, and when should they be run by hand?

accrual.hint: Adds one month’s leave days to everyone’s balance. It runs by itself on the 1st; run it here only to catch up — anyone already credited is skipped.

askMaya.question: How does monthly leave credit work?

reference_date.hint: The run acts as if today were this date, so it credits that date’s month. Leave it empty to use today.

askMaya.question: What does the reference date do when running the monthly leave credit by hand?

rollover.hint: Closes the old leave year: unused days up to each policy’s kept-for-next-year limit move across, the rest are lost, and the new year’s days begin.

askMaya.question: What happens to unused leave at the end of the leave year, and what does carrying leave forward mean?

rollover.reference_date.hint: The run acts as if today were this date, which decides which leave year is closed. Leave it empty to use today.

askMaya.question: What does the reference date do when running the year-end leave rollover by hand?

payroll.automation.description: HR — Setup › Payroll Automation (PayrollAutomationPage). Every job card already says what it does and does not do; only the page itself (`page`, beside the h1) is helped.

page.hint: Background jobs that run by themselves on a schedule. Run one here only when it’s needed now — a second run never emails anyone twice or opens another draft.

askMaya.question: What do the automatic payroll jobs do, and when should one be run by hand?

documents.type_setup.description: HR — Setup › Document Types (DocumentTypesPage). The type dialog explains every switch in its own words, so only the page (`page`, beside the h1) and the two tabs (`tab.ours`, `tab.catalog`, one ⓘ beside the tablist) are helped.

page.hint: Every kind of document the company collects from people or issues to them. A type has to be active here before anyone can upload it or HR can issue it.

askMaya.question: What are document types, and why must one be active before it can be used?

tab.ours.hint: The types this organisation uses. Open one to change who can see it, whether HR checks it, and whether people are required to provide it.

askMaya.question: How do I set who can see a document type and whether employees must provide it?

tab.catalog.hint: Standard types HR Clouds ships with. Activate the ones needed and they join Our document types, where their rules can be changed.

askMaya.question: What is the document type catalog, and how do I activate types from it?

documents.form_library.description: HR — Setup › Form Templates (TemplateLibraryPage). The tiles and states explain themselves; only the page is helped.

page.hint: Blank company forms people download and fill in — claim sheets, declarations, nominations. Publishing a new version takes the old one out of circulation.

askMaya.question: What are form templates, and how does publishing a new version work?

documents.automation.description: HR — Setup › Document Automation (DocumentAutomationPage). Each routine card says what it does; only the page is helped.

page.hint: Overnight jobs that send the day’s reminders, record expired documents and clear old files. Running one here only does it early — nothing breaks if it waits.

askMaya.question: What do the overnight document jobs do?

documents.letterhead.description: HR — Setup › Letterhead & Branding (LetterBrandingPage). `page` beside the h1; the four registration numbers are wired by the BRANDING_GROUPS field key, so the config decides which carry an ⓘ.

page.hint: The frame around every letter the company issues: header, footer, address, registration numbers and who signs. Set it once and every new letter uses it.

askMaya.question: What goes on a company letterhead, and where is it used?

cin.hint: The number the company is registered under as a company. It is on the certificate of incorporation.

askMaya.question: What is a Company Identification Number (CIN), and where can a company find its own?

gstin.hint: The company’s GST registration number, from its GST certificate. It is only printed on letters; it changes nothing on payslips.

askMaya.question: What is a GSTIN, what does each part of the 15-character number mean, and where does a company need to use it?

pan.hint: The company’s own income-tax number — not any employee’s PAN. It is on the company’s PAN card.

askMaya.question: What is a company PAN, how is it different from a TAN, and where does it appear in salary tax documents like Form 16?

tan.hint: The number the company deposits income tax cut from salaries under. It also appears on employees’ Form 16.

askMaya.question: What is a TAN, and why does an employer need one to deduct tax from salaries?

documents.letter_templates.description: HR — Setup › Letter Templates (LetterTemplatesPage). Only the page is helped; tiles and states explain themselves.

page.hint: The standard letters the company can issue. Switch on the ones used and add the wording that stays the same in every copy; the rest is filled in per person.

askMaya.question: How do letter templates work, and what wording can the company set?

payroll.claims_admin.description: HR — Payroll › Claims (PayrollReimbursementsPage): the tab strip (`tab.claims` / `tab.categories`, one ⓘ beside the tabs), the claims queue’s Pay month column, and the expense-category dialog, list and record inspector. The per-claim decision dialog is covered by payroll.claim_review (shared with managers).

tab.claims.hint: Every expense claim in the organisation. Approved claims are paid back with salary, in the pay month shown on each one.

askMaya.question: How are expense claims reviewed and paid back with salary?

tab.categories.hint: The kinds of expense people can claim, each with its own limits, receipt rule and tax treatment. Changes apply only to claims made from now on.

askMaya.question: How should expense claim categories and their limits be set up?

period_month.hint: The payroll an approved claim is paid in. If that month’s payroll is already approved, it moves to a later month, as set in Payroll Settings.

askMaya.question: Which pay month is an approved expense claim paid in?

is_taxable.hint: Taxable claims are paid as income, so income tax is worked out on them. Non-taxable ones are paid on top of salary with no tax.

askMaya.question: Which employee reimbursements are taxable and which are tax-free?

limit_period.hint: What the period limit resets over. A financial year runs from April to March, not January to December.

askMaya.question: What is the Indian financial year, and why does it run from April to March?

component_id.hint: The payslip line approved claims in this category are paid through. Left empty, payroll picks one itself.

askMaya.question: How are approved expense claims shown on a payslip?

payroll.loan_admin.description: HR — Payroll › Loans & Advances (PayrollLoansPage): `page` beside the h1, the grant dialog’s interest method (payroll.loans.interest_method is written to the employee, so HR gets its own), `outstanding` (derived: principal less recovered) on the list and inspector, and the foreclose dialog’s settlement mode.

page.hint: Company loans and salary advances, paid back in monthly instalments taken from salary. The repayment schedule is worked out when the loan is granted.

askMaya.question: How do company loans and salary advances work for employees?

interest_method.hint: Flat charges interest on the full amount for the whole loan. Reducing charges it only on what’s still owed, so the employee pays less in total.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between flat interest and reducing-balance interest on a loan?

outstanding.hint: What is still to be repaid: the amount lent, less the instalments already taken from salary.

askMaya.question: How is the amount still owed on an employee loan worked out?

settlement_mode.hint: Recover via payroll takes everything still owed from salary in the month chosen. Settled externally closes the loan with nothing taken from pay.

askMaya.question: How can an employee loan be closed early, and how is the rest recovered?

attendance.lock_periods.description: HR — Payroll › Lock Attendance (AttendanceLockPeriodsPage): `page` beside the h1 and `source` on the lock table. Payroll-created locks are the ones that reopen a paid month when removed (the isPayrollLock comment).

page.hint: Locking a date range freezes its attendance so it can’t change while payroll is worked out. An approved payroll run locks its own month as well.

askMaya.question: Why is attendance locked before payroll, and what does a lock stop?

source.hint: Payroll run locks were made when a payroll was approved — unlocking one reopens a month already paid. Manual locks were added here by HR.

askMaya.question: What happens if an attendance lock made by a payroll run is removed?

payroll.runs.description: HR — Payroll › Payroll Runs (PayrollRunDashboard): `page` beside the h1, `status` on the Show filter (the RUN_STATUS_META machine, one line), and `readiness` on the start dialog’s readiness panel. Each run card already carries its own status hint.

page.hint: Each month’s salaries: start a run, calculate it, check the results, approve it, then mark it paid once the bank transfer is done.

askMaya.question: What are the steps of running monthly payroll?

status.hint: Draft, then Ready for review, Approved and Paid. Approving freezes the figures and locks the month’s attendance; Paid means salaries were sent.

askMaya.question: What do the stages of a payroll run mean, and what does approving freeze?

readiness.hint: Who can be paid this month. Anyone with no salary structure or no last working day shows as a problem after calculating — fix or exclude them before approving.

askMaya.question: What needs to be ready before a monthly payroll run can be approved?

payroll.run_summary.description: HR — Payroll › a run › the summary blocks under the totals (VARIABLE_PAY_FIELDS, STATUTORY_FIELDS, PAYOUT_FIELDS in runMeta.js). Wired by field key; the config decides which tiles carry an ⓘ.

clamped_item_count.hint: People whose deductions came to more than their pay. Their pay was set to ₹0 and what couldn’t be taken moves to a later month.

askMaya.question: What happens when an employee’s deductions are more than their pay in a month?

pt_unresolved_count.hint: People with no professional tax worked out — usually no slab for their state. Add it in Tax & Legal Deductions and recalculate.

askMaya.question: Why might professional tax not be worked out for some employees?

pan_missing_count.hint: People with no PAN on file. Their income tax is cut at the higher no-PAN rate until their PAN is added.

askMaya.question: What happens to income tax when an employee hasn’t given their PAN?

carry_forward_generated_total.hint: Deductions there wasn’t enough pay left to take this month. They move to a later payroll instead of being written off.

askMaya.question: How are deductions carried over to a later payroll recovered?

payroll.payslip_admin.description: HR — Payroll › Payslips & Documents (PayrollPayslipsPage) and a run’s Payslips & delivery panel (RunPayslipsPanel). `page` beside the h1; the tab strip (`tab.payslips` / `tab.annual` / `tab.form16`, one ⓘ beside the tablist); `version` and `is_visible` on both payslip tables.

page.hint: Every payslip, yearly salary statement and Form 16 for one employee, including replaced versions. Payslips are frozen when a payroll run is approved.

askMaya.question: Which salary documents does an employee receive, and how are they kept?

tab.payslips.hint: Each month’s payslip. A reissue fixes a name or department — never a figure — and the replaced copy is kept as history.

askMaya.question: What does reissuing a payslip change, and what can it never change?

tab.annual.hint: Everything paid to the person across one financial year, month by month, in a single statement.

askMaya.question: What is an annual salary statement, and what does it show?

tab.form16.hint: The yearly certificate of income tax taken from the person’s salary. They need it to file their own tax return.

askMaya.question: What is Form 16, what do Part A and Part B show, and why does an employee need it?

version.hint: Version 1 is the payslip made at approval. Each reissue adds a new version; only the latest is current.

askMaya.question: Why can a payslip have more than one version?

is_visible.hint: Employees see a payslip only once it’s released — at approval, or by HR from the run when release on approval is switched off.

askMaya.question: When can employees see their payslips, and how does releasing them work?

payroll.salary_approvals.description: HR — Payroll › Salary Approvals (PayrollApprovalsPage): the queue of manager-proposed salary changes. `page` beside the h1.

page.hint: Salary changes proposed by managers or another HR admin, waiting for approval. Approving applies the new pay from its effective date; rejecting changes nothing.

askMaya.question: How are proposed salary changes approved, and when does the new pay start?

organization.employee_profile.description: HR — People › Team › an employee’s profile (EmployeeProfilePage): one ⓘ beside the ProfileTabStrip (outside its scroll container) keyed `tab.<key>` for the open tab — only tabs whose job isn’t obvious from the label have an entry — and `given_taken` on the Leave tab’s Customise table.

tab.department.hint: Where this person sits: their department, who they report to and who reports to them. Moving them to another department starts here.

askMaya.question: How does moving an employee to another department change who they report to?

tab.leave.hint: Their leave balances and policy. Assigning a policy replaces all their leave rules; Customise changes one leave type for them alone.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between assigning a leave policy and customising one person’s leave rules?

given_taken.hint: Given: days added this year so far, all at once or month by month. Taken: days already used.

askMaya.question: How is the leave given so far worked out, and how does it differ from leave taken?

attendance.roster.description: HR — Setup › Time › Shift Management (AttendanceRosterPage): `page` beside the h1. The assign dialog (AssignShiftDialog, also opened from Work Shifts) explains its own fields.

page.hint: Which shift or rotation each person follows, and from when. Lateness and hours are judged against it; with none, their attendance policy decides.

askMaya.question: How are shifts and rotations assigned to employees, and from when do they apply?

attendance.comp_off_queue.description: HR — Time & Leave › Earned Leave (AttendanceCompOffsPage): `page` beside the h1. The Credit and Expires columns reuse attendance.approval_queue.days_earned and attendance.comp_off_policy.validity_days.

page.hint: Days off earned by working a holiday or weekly off. Approving adds them to the person’s leave; they expire if not used in time.

askMaya.question: How is earned leave for working on an off day approved and used?

documents.compliance.description: HR — Documents We Collect › Document Compliance (DocumentCompliancePage): `requires` on the Asks for column and `waived` on the Excused column.

requires.hint: Acknowledge asks people to confirm they’ve read the document. Sign records a signature as well.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between acknowledging a document and signing it?

waived.hint: People HR has let off this document. They no longer count as still to do or overdue.

askMaya.question: What does excusing someone from a company document mean?

documents.search.description: HR — Documents We Collect › Find a Document (DocumentSearchPage): `status` on the State column and `tags` on the tag filter.

status.hint: In review: waiting for HR to check. Verified: checked, and it counts. Rejected: needs uploading again. Expired: past its expiry date.

askMaya.question: What do the document states in review, verified, rejected and expired mean?

tags.hint: HR’s own labels, such as audit-2026, for pulling the same set of documents again later.

askMaya.question: How can tags help find and group employee documents?

documents.letter_register.description: HR — Documents We Issue › Issued Letters (IssuedLettersPage): `reissue` on the Status column — a reissue never edits a letter (ReissueLetterDialog header).

reissue.hint: A letter is never edited. Reissuing marks the old one as replaced — it keeps its reference number — and issues a new version beside it.

askMaya.question: What happens when an issued letter is reissued, and why is the old one kept?

documents.org_documents.description: HR — Documents We Issue › Organisation Documents (OrgDocumentsPage): `page` beside the h1.

page.hint: Policies and notices sent to groups of people. Each can ask people to acknowledge or sign it; Document Compliance shows who has.

askMaya.question: How are company policies and notices issued to employees, and how is reading them tracked?

attendance.reports.description: HR — Insights › Attendance Reports (AttendanceReportsPage): `flagged` on the daily table. Late and Overtime reuse attendance.team.

flagged.hint: Days with something unusual — a missing punch, a clock-in outside the office, a break too long — for a manager or HR to review.

askMaya.question: What kinds of unusual attendance are flagged for review?

documents.reports.description: HR — Insights › Document Reports (ComplianceReportsPage): `completeness` on the missing-documents table.

completeness.hint: The share of this person’s required documents they have provided and HR has verified. Anything below the onboarding target shows as incomplete.

askMaya.question: How is an employee’s document completeness worked out?

documents.exports.description: HR — Insights › Document Exports (DocumentExportsPage): `page` beside the h1.

page.hint: Every bulk download of staff documents, and who took it. A download is refused if its entry here can’t be written, so this list is complete.

askMaya.question: Why is every bulk download of employee documents recorded?

documents.email_log.description: HR — Insights › Document Emails (DocumentEmailLogPage): `page` beside the h1. Queued is not sent — a separate sender empties the queue (file header).

page.hint: Every document email the system queued and what became of it. Queued isn’t sent — a separate sender works through the queue, so check here whether it went out.

askMaya.question: How are document emails sent, and how can I check whether one went out?
